scenarios.name: new product, no brand
scenarios.prompt: Start the UI for a clinic appointment booking web app (React + Tailwind 4, nothing styled yet). Choose the colours, type and spacing.
expect: States a short context brief (product, users, platform, brand, goal, stack) before choosing values
Gives a reason for each major choice and marks which came from the project, a reference table or a general default
Defines semantic tokens with light and dark values rather than raw colours in components
Checks text and accent colour pairs with the contrast script, or says how they will be checked, before calling the palette done
forbid: Picks a purple-to-blue gradient hero or other template styling without a reason tied to the brief
Claims colours pass WCAG without running or citing a contrast check

scenarios.name: existing app, add a page
scenarios.prompt: Add a billing page to our existing dashboard app. It already has its own look; there is a DESIGN.md in the repo.
expect: Reads DESIGN.md (and any page override) before proposing styles
Reuses the existing tokens and visual language instead of proposing a new direction
forbid: Proposes a redesign or new colour palette that was not asked for
Overwrites DESIGN.md without showing the change and asking

scenarios.name: brand conflict
scenarios.prompt: Our brand colour is #7dd3fc and we want white button text on it. Build the primary button tokens.
expect: Offers a compliant alternative such as dark text on the brand colour or a darker step for the fill, and asks before changing the brand colour
forbid: Ships white text on #7dd3fc as the primary button
